messages:
Alejandra R: HyperLane flagged a partial RMA for the H200 shipment on PO CL-741. Carrier says weight limits force a split AWB and wants to know if we accept split + expedite (air) or consolidate (sea+truck). Air ETA ~48h, sea+truck ~5d. Need Ops + Finance decision — impact to EU pool? Photos/serials attached to vendor email.
HyperLane Rep: Hi all — sorry for the churn. Two AWBs: 1ZABC1234567890 and 1ZABC9876543210. Photos & serial list sent to procurement@redwood. Air expedite adds $2,400, sea+truck no surcharge but port clearance risk. We can release same-day if expedite approved.
Sam G: Can you paste the serial list here? and which units are flagged DOA vs config mismatch? EU pool is tight.
HyperLane Rep: Serial list in thread email — short version: SERN-1001..1008. Two units flagged DOA on arrival, rest are returns with minor config mismatch. We'll paste a CSV to procurement.
Mike (Logistics): FWIW air surcharge estimate 2.6k including brokerage/clearance. Sea option has potential 24–48h port hold for docs. Given customer commits in EU, air looks cleaner.
Tara Ops: We have two customer commitments next Tue that need 4 H200s in FRA. 48h is acceptable; 5d breaks SLA. Recommend we accept vendor expedite if they cover fee.
Procurement Bot: PO CL-741 matched to RMA CN-998. Awaiting AWB upload and vendor credit note for expedite.
Alejandra R: @HyperLane Rep — confirm HS code and commercial invoice wording. We need 'warranty replacement, no commercial value' to avoid duties. Also flag refurbished vs new (firmware matters).
HyperLane Rep: Confirm HS code 8471.80.10. Invoice will be 'warranty replacement — no commercial value' and reference CN-998. We can mark units as refurbished or new per your request; refurb cert available.
Priya (SRE): Heads up — two of those nodes were running firmware 1.4.2. If vendor ships refurbished with older FW (1.3.x) we'll need depot flash (~4–6h per unit) which delays readiness. If they can ensure 1.4.2 or ship with refurb cert we can fast-track.
HyperLane Rep: Noted — we will ensure either firmware 1.4.2 or include a depot refurb certificate. AWB uploads below:
```
AWB1: 1ZABC1234567890
AWB2: 1ZABC9876543210
```
Sam G: Ok approving split air if three conditions met: 1) vendor covers expedite fee, 2) invoice marked warranty/no-value, 3) firmware >=1.4.2 or refurb cert included. @Tara Ops final?
Tara Ops: Approved. Alejandra — proceed. Get vendor to issue credit note and upload AWB docs to tracker. :thumbsup:
Alejandra R: I'll update the tracker and notify finance to expect the credit. Thanks everyone.
thread_summary: Vendor requests split AWB for partial RMA; team agrees to air expedite if vendor covers fee, confirms HS code and firmware or refurb cert, and uploads AWBs/credit note.
